children: Aspen Aerogels posted an investor presentation highlighting a Q3 2026 outlook, $202M LTM Q2 ’26 revenue and $153.4M cash.
Posted investor presentation on Sept 15, 2026; presentation furnished as Exhibit 99.1 to Form 8-K.
$202M LTM Q2 ’26 revenue and segment splits: $111M Thermal Barrier, $92M Energy Industrial.
$153.4M cash and equivalents as of June 30, 2026 to support East Providence recovery and operations.
Targets: return to positive Adjusted EBITDA in Q3 2026 and ~$175M revenue run-rate for breakeven by end-2027.
Operating capacity supports $600M+ annual revenue with limited incremental capital; pursuing European EV ramps and Energy Industrial growth.
